content:
Do extensive research before you answer.

Which side is more likely to win? You can do as much research as you'd like in order to come to your decision. Answer with only `yes` or `no`. https://voterguide.sos.ca.gov/propositions/43/

parameters.prompt: Fetch https://voterguide.sos.ca.gov/propositions/43/ and extract all information about Proposition 43, including its title, summary, fiscal impact, arguments for and against, and supporters/opponents.

parameters.query: "Proposition 43" California 2026 OR 2024 OR 2022 OR 2020 OR 2018 OR 2016 OR 2014

output: Search results for ""Proposition 43" California 2026 OR 2024 OR 2022 OR 2020 OR 2018 OR 2016 OR 2014" returned.

parameters.query: "Proposition 43" California 2026 polls OR polling OR campaign finance OR endorsements OR CalMatters OR Ballotpedia
"ACA 13" OR "SCA" "Proposition 43" California 2026 local special tax two-thirds

output: Search results for ""Proposition 43" California 2026 polls OR polling OR campaign finance OR endorsements OR CalMatters OR Ballotpedia" returned.
Search results for ""ACA 13" OR "SCA" "Proposition 43" California 2026 local special tax two-thirds" returned.

parameters.query: "ACA 1" OR "ACA 10" OR "ACA 13" California 2024 ballot "Limits Voters' Ability to Raise Revenues for Local Government Services"
"LIMITS VOTERS' ABILITY TO RAISE REVENUES FOR LOCAL GOVERNMENT SERVICES" California ballot proposition

output: Search results for ""ACA 1" OR "ACA 10" OR "ACA 13" California 2024 ballot "Limits Voters' Ability to Raise Revenues for Local Government Services"" returned.
Search results for ""LIMITS VOTERS' ABILITY TO RAISE REVENUES FOR LOCAL GOVERNMENT SERVICES" California ballot proposition" returned.

parameters.prompt: Fetch the full text of https://voterguide.sos.ca.gov/propositions/43/ and any subpages like https://voterguide.sos.ca.gov/propositions/43/analysis.htm and https://voterguide.sos.ca.gov/propositions/43/arguments-rebuttals.htm and https://voterguide.sos.ca.gov/propositions/43/title-summary.htm and return the verbatim text.

output: Search results for ""YESon43.com" OR "Noprop43CA.com" OR "Prop 43" California 2026" returned.

parameters.prompt: Fetch https://ballotpedia.org/California_Proposition_43,_Two-Thirds_Vote_Requirement_for_Local_Special_Tax_Initiatives_and_Property_Tax_Initiative_Prohibition_Amendment_(2026) and extract all polling, campaign finance, endorsements, and background information.

output: Search results for ""Proposition 43" "PPIC" OR "Berkeley IGS" California 2026 poll" returned.

parameters.prompt: Fetch https://ballotpedia.org/California_Proposition_43,_Two-Thirds_Vote_Requirement_for_Local_Special_Tax_Initiatives_and_Property_Tax_Initiative_Prohibition_Amendment_(2026) and return the exact verbatim text of the Polls section, Campaign finance section, and Endorsements section.
